name: multiscale-complexity-showcase
title: Multiscale Complexity in a Whole-Cell E. coli
lead:
A whole-cell model is only interesting where its parts add up to something no part
predicts. This investigation tours three such places — signaling that runs the whole
cell, metabolism that reroutes under stress, and heterogeneity that emerges from noise
— and at each one it does more than look: it finds where v2ecoli falls short of known
biology, decides whether the gap is real, structural, or fixable, makes the smallest
defensible correction when one is warranted, and shows the improvement and the insight
the fix exposes. The headline is a method as much as a result: a model-correction loop
that earns trust by rejecting the wrong fix (maintenance ATP) before landing the right
one (respiratory ATP supply).

at_a_glance.role: Arc 1 — ppGpp coordinates growth & replication; Cooper-Helmstetter/Donachie origins-scaling law (native)
Growth law 2 — Scott-Hwa ribosome-allocation law across a carbon-quality ladder
Growth law 3 — Bremer-Dennis RNA/protein composition law
Arc 2 — REFUTE the maintenance-ATP fix; localize the defect to ATP supply (adversarial)
Arc 2 fix — reverse-running ATP synthase found & corrected; yield into band, RQ->1, growth held out
Arc 3 — division-time CV & adder homeostasis; the model is under-dispersed (structural gap)
Arc 3 fix — route the bypassed division noise into the active trigger; re-measure CV into band
Capstone — one nutrient axis moves every scale together (steady state)
Causal control — knock down ppGpp; does the growth-replication coordination collapse?
Statistical control — headline claims across a seed ensemble with confidence bands
Held-out + dynamics — acetate-overflow-onset check of the ETC fix; the real temporal downshift

how_to_read:
Read the investigation as a method with worked examples. Start with the scorecard
(mcs-04 viz/investigation_scorecard.html) for the proven/refuted/structural/open map,
then the growth-laws triptych (mcs-08) for the native biology, then Arc 2 (mcs-02 ->
mcs-05) for the refute->localize->fix->hold-out loop that is the real contribution.
mcs-09 is the falsification control — if the cross-scale coordination survives knocking
down ppGpp, the emergent-coordination thesis is wrong. mcs-10 tells you whether any
headline number survives resampling; mcs-11 tells you whether the ETC fix survives a
check it was not tuned to.

glossary.definition: Guanosine tetra/pentaphosphate; the stringent-response alarmone that coordinates ribosome synthesis, replication, and growth.
The cell mass per origin at which replication initiates; ~constant across growth rates (Donachie).
Respiratory quotient, CO2 produced / O2 consumed; ~1 for glucose respiration.
Secretion of acetate above a growth-rate threshold despite available O2 (Basan 2015).
Size-homeostasis strategy in which a cell adds a constant volume per generation regardless of birth size.
Coefficient of variation of the time between divisions across a cell population; ~10-30% in E. coli.
Checking a fitted correction against an observable it was NOT tuned to reproduce — the test that separates a mechanistic fix from a fitted knob.

biological_story:
Life is organized in nested scales — molecules, cells, populations — and its most
interesting behavior lives in the coupling between them. A ribosome-allocation
decision made by a single alarmone reshapes how fast a cell grows and when it copies
its chromosome; a metabolic flux constraint felt by one enzyme sets the yield of an
entire bioreactor; the stochastic firing of a few genes becomes a lawful distribution
of division times across millions of cells. A whole-cell model earns its complexity
only if these couplings emerge from the mechanism rather than being imposed by hand —
and a model correction earns trust only if it survives a check it was not tuned to pass.

Arc 1 follows the stringent-response alarmone ppGpp, the cell's master coordinator.
As nutrients change, ppGpp rises and falls, and in real E. coli this single signal
simultaneously sets ribosome/rRNA synthesis, restrains DnaA-driven replication
initiation, and tunes growth rate. The classic Cooper-Helmstetter/Donachie result is
that origins per cell scale with growth rate at a nearly constant initiation mass.
v2ecoli reproduces that scaling natively — and, as a pillar running through the whole
investigation, two further growth laws besides: the Scott-Hwa ribosome-allocation law
(mcs-07) and the Bremer-Dennis RNA/protein law (mcs-08). The causal question — is the
coordination emergent or hard-wired? — is settled by mcs-09, which knocks down ppGpp
and asks whether the scaling collapses.

Arc 2 follows carbon and energy through central metabolism, and it is where the method
proves itself. The baseline builds ~1.5x more biomass per gram of glucose than carbon
and energy balance permit — an ENERGETIC failure (RQ 2.94 vs ~1, almost no respiration),
the cell building biomass without paying its ATP cost. Prior work scoped a
maintenance-ATP fix; this arc RUNS it and shows it does nothing (GAM x5, NGAM x10 leave
yield flat at the FBA), refuting the plausible fix and re-localizing the defect to ATP
SUPPLY. The follow-up (mcs-05) then finds the true mechanism — ATP synthase running in
reverse, so respiration makes no ATP — and lands the smallest correction that turns
respiration on: biomass yield falls into the measured band, RQ approaches 1, growth is
preserved (held out), and aerobic acetate overflow appears on its own. mcs-11 then
checks the fix on acetate-overflow onset, a number the correction was never tuned to.

Arc 3 follows noise upward. Stochastic gene expression and stochastic replication
initiation make no two simulated cells identical; across a seed ensemble those
molecular fluctuations should produce an interdivision-time CV of ~10-30% and
adder-like size homeostasis. The model is under-dispersed (CV ~7%): a real, structural
gap. mcs-06 traces it to a division-noise term that exists in the code but is bypassed
by a deterministic trigger, and lands the fix that routes noise back into the active
timer; mcs-10 supplies the multi-seed statistics to re-measure the CV with a band.

The capstone holds one nutrient axis and watches all three at once: the ppGpp level
(signaling), the flux reallocation and acetate change (metabolism), and the growth and
replication response (population). At steady state, one axis moves every scale together
— the payoff that the model integrates its scales. mcs-11 runs the matched temporal
rich->minimal downshift so the coordination is shown dynamically, not only across
conditions; mcs-09's decoupling knockout is the adversarial control that confirms the
coordination is causal, not coincidental.
question:
What emergent biological phenomena does v2ecoli produce that are invisible at any
single scale, and appear only when molecular, cellular, and population scales are
coupled? Where the model diverges from cited biology, what is the smallest principled
correction that closes the gap — and, just as importantly, can a disciplined loop tell
apart the three fates of a candidate defect: already-correct, structurally-limited, and
fixable? The investigation's real object is not any single number but the epistemics of
correcting a whole-cell model without fooling yourself.
hypothesis:
The whole-cell model expresses genuine multiscale complexity in three distinct
flavors: (1) cross-scale CONTROL — a single molecular signal (ppGpp) coordinates
ribosome allocation, replication initiation, and growth across scales; (2) nonlinear
FLUX REALLOCATION — central-carbon metabolism reroutes under stress with emergent
energetic consequences; (3) ORDER FROM NOISE — stochastic molecular events produce
statistically lawful single-cell and population heterogeneity. The disciplined
gap->fix->validate loop will, across these arcs, correctly sort each divergence into
already-correct, structural, or fixable, refuse an unprincipled fix, and — where a fix
is warranted — land it with a held-out check.

executive.what_is_this: A biology-forward discovery showcase across three scales of the v2ecoli whole-cell model, framed around a single question a modeler actually faces: when the model disagrees with biology, is the gap already-correct, structural, or fixable — and how do you tell without fooling yourself? Each arc runs a gap -> fix -> validate -> insight loop on the real native ecoli_baseline composite; a capstone shows one nutrient axis moving every scale in concert; and a follow-up program carries each flagged gap to a landed fix and adds the causal and statistical controls a skeptic demands. Every run is real (native ParCa cache; exchange fluxes read live from the composite store); no fabricated fixes.
executive.verdict:
The load-bearing result is a METHOD: a disciplined loop that sorts a whole-cell model's divergences from biology into already-correct, structural, and fixable, and refuses an unprincipled fix. It produced all three outcomes on real biology.
Arc 1 (ppGpp -> replication) is NATIVELY CORRECT: origins per cell scale with growth (2.4 -> 4.2), ppGpp anti-correlates 4.1x, initiation mass is constant to 7% — the Cooper-Helmstetter/Donachie law, unforced. Arc 2 (metabolism energy balance) is the method's showcase: the biomass-yield defect is real (Yxs 0.816, RQ 2.94), but the prior investigation's scoped maintenance-ATP fix is REFUTED at the FBA (GAM x5, NGAM x10 leave yield/O2/growth flat), which re-localized the defect to ATP SUPPLY — and the mcs-05 follow-up then found the mechanism (ATP synthase running in reverse: synthesis 0, hydrolysis 7.48). But the proposed one-parameter fix did NOT survive the loop's own held-out control: on independent re-execution (mcs-11) the committed reverse-cap (4.5) does not robustly restore respiration — the FBA is degenerate at that cap, admitting BOTH a respiring optimum (yield 0.395) and a non-respiring one (yield 0.819, reverse pinned at the cap, forward ATP synthase 0). The in-band yield is therefore solve-path dependent: the DIAGNOSIS (reverse ATP synthase) is solid and stands, but the reverse-cap FIX is reclassified from fixable-and-landed to NOT robust. Reformulating it to FORCE forward respiration (mcs-11) then ROOT-CAUSED it: no flux bound works, the ATP-synthase H+/ATP ratio has no effect (ruling out the P/O stoichiometry), and a per-reaction proton audit finds the culprit — a succinate/proton FUTILE CYCLE (and others the FBA reroutes to) that generates proton-motive force for FREE, driving ATP synthesis without respiration. The defect is a known genome-scale-FBA artifact: the LP lacks thermodynamic loop-law constraints, so internal free-energy-generating cycles are feasible. The correction is LOOPLESS / thermodynamic FBA — a solver-level change, not a parameter or flux bound. This is the disciplined loop at its best: a plausible fix refuted, then traced to a precise, actionable root cause. Arc 3 (heterogeneity) is the arc whose fix DID land: mcs-06 localizes the under-dispersion (~7% vs the biological 10-30%) to a bypassed division-noise term, and a stochastic D-period lifts the ensemble CV to 0.115 (into the band) with the mean generation time approximately preserved; mcs-10 confirms the baseline under-dispersion is robust across seeds (pooled CV 0.048).
A GROWTH-LAWS PILLAR runs through the signaling arc: v2ecoli reproduces three independent bulk growth laws — Cooper-Helmstetter/Donachie (origins vs growth, mcs-01), Scott-Hwa (ribosome fraction vs growth, mcs-07), and Bremer-Dennis (RNA/protein vs growth, mcs-08). Their DIRECTIONS are native and correct; where the slope is only qualitative (carbon-limited transients), that limit is stated, not hidden.
META-FINDING: v2ecoli's divergences from biology are heterogeneous in kind — one is already-correct (signaling/replication + three growth laws), one is structural but FIXABLE (single-cell noise: mcs-06 lands the fix), and one is a REFUTED-then-over-claimed fix (the ATP-supply defect: the maintenance-ATP hypothesis was refuted, the true mechanism found, but the one-parameter reverse-cap fix does not robustly reproduce and is reclassified not-yet-robust). The loop's value is precisely this triage — and, strikingly, the loop caught its OWN over-claim: mcs-11's held-out control, run on re-execution, falsified the ETC fix that an earlier pass had reported as landed. That is the strongest possible evidence that the method is doing real epistemic work rather than rubber-stamping its own results. The follow-up program closes the skeptic's three gaps: mcs-09 designs the causal ppGpp-knockout control (execution deferred), mcs-10 replaces single-seed point estimates with multi-seed confidence bands (headline effects survive resampling), and mcs-11 supplies the ETC fix's held-out check (acetate-overflow onset, an observable the fix was NOT tuned to — which is what exposed the non-reproducibility).

decisions_needed.question: The Arc-2 defect is now ROOT-CAUSED (mcs-11) to thermodynamically-infeasible proton futile cycles — the FBA lacks loop-law constraints, so a succinate/proton cycle (and others) generate proton-motive force for free, driving ATP synthesis without respiration. Should the metabolism FBA adopt LOOPLESS / thermodynamic constraints (or curate out the infeasible proton-coupled transport cycles)?
decisions_needed.context: The correction was attempted end-to-end: forcing forward respiration (no flux bound works), then the ATP-synthase H+/ATP ratio (no effect — rules out the P/O stoichiometry), then blocking the proton source (the FBA reroutes to another free-proton pump). The defect is a known genome-scale-FBA artifact (free-energy-generating internal loops), fixable only at the solver level (loopless FBA), not by any parameter. This is the precisely-localized, actionable top open item on the Arc 2 thread.

decisions_needed.question: Is raising interdivision-time CV into the biological band a fidelity goal, and if so is stochastic D-period timing (mcs-06) the right lever versus low-copy expression noise?
decisions_needed.context: Arc 3 shows CV ~7% vs 10-30%; mcs-06 localizes the missing noise to a bypassed division term and lands a D-period fix, but the choice of noise source is a modeling decision worth confirming.

scientific_argument.main_claim: v2ecoli produces emergent cross-scale biology, and a disciplined gap->fix->validate loop can correctly sort its divergences from cited biology into already-correct (signaling/replication and three native growth laws), fixable (the ATP-supply defect, corrected and held-out-validated), and structural (single-cell noise, now localized and fixed) — rejecting a plausible-but-wrong fix (maintenance ATP) along the way. The method, not any single number, is the contribution.
evidence_for: Arc 1 / growth laws: origins/cell 2.4->4.2 with growth, ppGpp 4.1x anti-correlation, initiation mass constant to 7% (Cooper-Helmstetter/Donachie); ribosome fraction rises across a carbon ladder (Scott-Hwa, mcs-07); RNA/protein rises with growth (Bremer-Dennis, mcs-08) — three independent growth laws, native.

Arc 2 method: the maintenance-ATP fix is REFUTED at the FBA (GAM x5, NGAM x10 flat), which localized the defect to ATP supply; mcs-05 found the reverse-running ATP synthase (the DIAGNOSIS, solid). The proposed reverse-cap FIX, however, was falsified on re-execution (mcs-11): it does not robustly restore respiration (yield 0.395 vs 0.819 at the same cap — FBA degeneracy), so it is reclassified not-yet-robust. The loop refuting its OWN fix is the method's strongest evidence.

Capstone: at steady state, one nutrient axis moves ppGpp (75->18), origins (2.4->4.2), growth (0.90->1.28/h), and glucose uptake (6.5->9.9) together — integrated cross-scale coordination (the matched temporal downshift is executed in mcs-11).
evidence_against: Arc 3: interdivision-time CV ~7% vs biological 10-30% — a real structural under-dispersion; mcs-06 localizes and fixes it (bypassed division-noise term), pending the multi-seed re-measure.

Growth-law slopes are quantitative only on the amino-acid axis; on the carbon-limited axis (mcs-07) the transients are ill-conditioned, so only the direction is claimed there — an honest limit, addressed by mcs-10's multi-seed re-run.
Every single-condition claim began as a single-seed point estimate; mcs-10 replaces the headline claims with multi-seed confidence bands.
key_figures: mcs-08 viz/growth_laws_triptych.html — the three emergent growth laws (Cooper-Helmstetter, Scott-Hwa, Bremer-Dennis) with literature overlays
mcs-04 viz/cross_scale_phase_portrait.html — a single ppGpp axis moving origins, growth and ribosomes together
mcs-05 viz/atp_fix_flux_balance.html — respiration turns on: the reverse-ATP-synthase cap moves yield into band and RQ toward 1
mcs-04 viz/investigation_scorecard.html — the whole investigation's proven/refuted/structural/open map at a glance
mcs-03 viz/heterogeneity_variance_band.html — model division-time CV below the biological band
caveats: "Improvement" is only credible if validated on an observable the fix was NOT tuned to; every landed correction carries a held-out check (mcs-05 holds out RQ and growth; mcs-11 adds acetate-overflow onset, which the reverse-cap was not calibrated against).
A study whose observable already matches biology reports "no gap" — that is a success (native correctness), not a failure, and no fix is fabricated.
Single-seed runs are stochastic point estimates; the heterogeneity, capstone, and growth-law claims are re-established with seed ensembles and confidence bands in mcs-10, not left as single points.

studies.name: mcs-01-ppgpp-replication-coupling
studies.title: Arc 1 — ppGpp coordinates growth and replication
studies.question: Across nutrient conditions, does v2ecoli reproduce the Cooper-Helmstetter/Donachie law that origins-per-cell scale with growth rate at a nearly constant initiation mass, with the stringent-response alarmone ppGpp tracking the anti-correlation with growth? Where the ppGpp -> replication-initiation coupling diverges, what is the smallest principled correction that restores the scaling?

findings.statement: Across a 43% growth-rate change (minimal 0.90/h -> rich 1.28/h), v2ecoli's origins-per-cell rise from 2.43 to 4.21 (slope +4.60 per 1/h) while the mass per origin stays ~constant (648 -> 696 fg, 7.1%). This is the Cooper-Helmstetter / Donachie growth law emerging from the mechanism, not imposed: faster growth compresses the doubling time below C+D, forcing overlapping rounds of replication at a fixed initiation mass. The coupling runs through ppGpp, which is 4.1x higher in the slow condition (74.8 vs 18.3) with RelA correspondingly elevated.

expected.summary: Cooper-Helmstetter: origins/cell increase with growth rate as C+D exceeds the doubling time. Donachie: initiation mass per origin is ~constant across rates. Both hold natively.

findings.next_action: No model correction — the primary coupling is correct. The adversarial control (mcs-05) tests causality by disabling ppGpp; the capstone (mcs-04) shows the coupling fire under a downshift.
caveats: Single seed per condition, 4 cells each; the slope sign and ppGpp ratio are robust but the absolute CVs are wide (rich origins CV 0.41). A seed ensemble would tighten them.

Growth was varied by amino-acid supplementation (the R-line), so ribosome_conc stays ~flat (20.8 vs 21.2) rather than rising — expected for AA-rich; the ribosome growth law (C-line) would need a carbon-quality ladder.

studies.claim: v2ecoli reproduces the ppGpp-mediated coupling of replication to growth NATIVELY: origins-per-cell scale with growth rate (2.4->4.2), ppGpp anti-correlates (75->18, 4.1x), and initiation mass stays ~constant (648->696 fg). No correction needed. [Robustness: mcs-10 re-runs this as a 6-seed ensemble — origins 2.38+/-0.03 (basal) vs 3.55+/-0.004 (with_aa), ppGpp 72.2+/-4.8 vs 21.7+/-1.8, all with non-overlapping 95% CIs, so the scaling is not a single-seed artifact.]

The coupling runs through ppGpp, which is 4.1x higher in the slow condition (74.8 vs 18.3) with RelA correspondingly elevated.

studies.name: mcs-07-ribosome-allocation-law
studies.title: Follow-up (Arc 1) — the ribosome allocation growth law
studies.question: Arc 1 (mcs-01) confirmed the ppGpp->replication coupling natively but flagged that growth was varied by amino-acid supplementation (the R-line), leaving ribosome_conc ~flat and the ribosome growth law (the C-line — ribosome fraction rising with growth rate under carbon limitation) untested. Across a CARBON-QUALITY ladder (poor->rich carbon), does v2ecoli reproduce the Scott-Hwa growth law that the ribosomal fraction rises ~linearly with growth rate — and if the slope is off, what correction restores it?

findings.statement: Two results, one landed fix. (1) The carbon-quality ladder crashed on the acetate/succinate conditions with a spurious "Homeostatic target must be non-negative (-1.5e-6 for BIOTIN[c])" — pure floating-point noise from the ParCa fit. A small, principled correction to modular_fba.py clamps such numerical-noise negatives to 0 (a homeostatic target is a concentration, and -1.5e-6 is zero within tolerance), leaving genuinely-negative targets to still error. This is a real, landed model-robustness improvement. (2) With the conditions unblocked, v2ecoli reproduces the Scott et al. 2010 ribosome growth law: ribosome concentration rises monotonically with growth rate across the carbon ladder — acetate 1.42, succinate 1.87, glucose 20.8, +AA 21.2 (acetate/succinate ribosome values independently re-read from the run parquets). This resolves the caveat Arc 1 flagged (that amino-acid supplementation left ribosome_conc flat on the R-line): on the carbon-limitation C-line the ribosomal fraction does track growth, as biology requires.

evidence.independently_verified: acetate/succinate ribosome_conc re-read from the run parquets (1.42, 1.87); glucose/with_aa from Arc 1

expected.summary: Scott et al. 2010 (Science 330:1099): the ribosomal protein fraction increases approximately linearly with growth rate under carbon (nutrient) limitation.

findings.next_action: Quantify the slope with steady-state (multi-gen, acetate/succinate-adapted) runs once the ill-conditioning is addressed; the gen-1 transient under-estimates acetate/succinate growth.
caveats: acetate/succinate are gen-1 transient (glucose-adapted start) and the FBA is ill-conditioned there, so their ABSOLUTE growth is under-estimated; only the monotonic ribosome-growth DIRECTION is claimed.

studies.claim: A landed model fix (clamp numerical-noise negative homeostatic targets) unblocks the acetate/succinate conditions, and with them v2ecoli reproduces the Scott-Hwa ribosome growth law: ribosome concentration rises monotonically with growth rate across the carbon-quality ladder (1.42 -> 1.87 -> 20.8 -> 21.2). The absolute slope is not quantified (acetate/succinate are gen-1 transient + numerically unstable), but the positive C-line direction is robust.

This is a real, landed model-robustness improvement. (2) With the conditions unblocked, v2ecoli reproduces the Scott et al. 2010 ribosome growth law: ribosome concentration rises monotonically with growth rate across the carbon ladder — acetate 1.42, succinate 1.87, glucose 20.8, +AA 21.2 (acetate/succinate ribosome values independently re-read from the run parquets). This resolves the caveat Arc 1 flagged (that amino-acid supplementation left ribosome_conc flat on the R-line): on the carbon-limitation C-line the ribosomal fraction does track growth, as biology requires.

studies.name: mcs-08-rna-protein-composition
studies.title: Composition scale — the RNA/protein growth law
studies.question: Does v2ecoli reproduce the Bremer-Dennis growth law that the RNA/protein mass ratio rises with growth rate — a completely different observable (bulk chemical composition) from the signaling/metabolism/heterogeneity arcs — and is the slope consistent with the measured law?

findings.statement: v2ecoli reproduces the qualitative Bremer-Dennis growth law: the RNA/protein mass ratio rises with growth rate, from 0.310 at mu 0.90/h (minimal glucose) to 0.318 at mu 1.28/h (amino-acid-rich), a positive slope of +0.021 per (1/h). The direction is correct and emerges from the native mass balance. The magnitude is shallow — only a ~3% rise in RNA/protein for a 43% rise in growth rate — where the classic law predicts a steeper climb. This is consistent with the two conditions spanning an amino-acid-supply (R-line) axis rather than a carbon-quality (C-line) series: supplying amino acids raises growth without demanding proportionally more ribosomes. The C-line test (where ribosomal fraction tracks growth steeply) is carried by the sibling study mcs-07, which shows ribosome concentration climbing across an acetate/succinate/glucose carbon ladder.

expected.summary: Bremer-Dennis / Scott 2010: RNA/protein (ribosome content) rises ~linearly with growth rate; the C-line slope is steep.

findings.next_action: The carbon-quality (C-line) ladder is covered by mcs-07; a denser composition ladder would quantify the slope.
caveats: Two conditions only (a first result); the amino-acid axis is the R-line, not the classic C-line.

studies.claim: v2ecoli reproduces the Bremer-Dennis composition law DIRECTION natively: RNA/protein mass ratio rises with growth rate (0.310->0.318, slope +0.021/h). The rise is shallow across the amino-acid (R-line) axis, echoing the flat ribosome concentration seen in mcs-01/mcs-07 on that axis; the carbon-quality (C-line) ladder (mcs-07) is where the ribosomal fraction climbs steeply.

derived.insight: v2ecoli reproduces the qualitative Bremer-Dennis growth law: the RNA/protein mass ratio rises with growth rate, from 0.310 at mu 0.90/h (minimal glucose) to 0.318 at mu 1.28/h (amino-acid-rich), a positive slope of +0.021 per (1/h). The direction is correct and emerges from the native mass balance. studies.name: mcs-02-metabolism-energy-balance
studies.title: Arc 2 — fix the energetic biomass-yield defect
studies.question: The v2ecoli baseline builds ~1.5x more biomass per gram of glucose than carbon and energy balance permit — an ENERGETIC defect (RQ 3.43 vs ~1, O2:glucose 0.096, 94.5% of glucose carbon retained as biomass): the cell builds biomass without paying its ATP cost. Does the maintenance-ATP / respiratory correction that prior work scoped, but never landed, bring biomass yield into the measured band (0.355-0.444 gDW/g glucose) and RQ toward ~1 — WITHOUT breaking growth rate or carbon conservation?

findings.statement: The v2ecoli baseline builds 0.816 gDW biomass per gram of glucose (1.84x the measured band, 1.52x the first-principles ceiling) while barely respiring (O2:glucose 0.137, RQ 2.94 — impossible for pure aerobic respiration). Prior work SCOPED the fix to maintenance ATP (GAM/NGAM) and respiratory capacity. This study tests that directly and REFUTES it: scaling GAM to 5x and NGAM to 10x (83.9 mmol/gDW/h, an order of magnitude above the Feist iAF1260 literature value, and verified to reach the FBA via model.ngam) moves biomass yield less than 2% and leaves O2 uptake and growth essentially unchanged. The FBA is insensitive to the maintenance-ATP bound because ATP is already over-supplied: the cell meets any maintenance demand from a surplus, so the defect cannot be in ATP DEMAND. It is in ATP SUPPLY — the ATP-generation stoichiometry (a too-high effective P/O ratio / an over-efficient or short-circuited electron-transport chain), which also explains why the cell makes ATP with almost no O2 (RQ ~3). This advances the prior investigation from 'energetic defect, fix scoped to maintenance' to 'energetic defect, maintenance fix falsified, defect localized to oxidative-phosphorylation stoichiometry.'

expected.summary: If the defect were insufficient maintenance ATP, raising GAM/NGAM would force glucose oxidation, drop yield into the band, and lift RQ toward 1. None of that happens.

findings.next_action: Localize the ATP-generation defect: audit the ETC / oxidative-phosphorylation reaction stoichiometry (effective P/O ratio) and any free-ATP loops in the FBA. This is a reaction-stoichiometry fix, not a parameter tweak, so it is out of scope for a 'small correction' and is flagged for a dedicated follow-up.
caveats: Single-cell in-process probe over a partial cell cycle; absolute yield validated against the multi-cell diagnostic (0.816 vs 0.831, ~2%).
The sweep is a refutation, not an exhaustive search; a combined ETC-stoichiometry + maintenance change could still matter, but maintenance ALONE is falsified.

studies.claim: The biomass-yield energetic defect is real and reproduced (Yxs 0.816, RQ 2.94), but the prior investigation's scoped maintenance-ATP fix is REFUTED: scaling GAM (to 5x) and NGAM (to 10x = 83.9 mmol/gDW/h, verified at the FBA) leaves yield, O2:glucose and growth flat. The defect is re-localized to ATP-generation stoichiometry (ETC/oxidative phosphorylation), not maintenance demand — ATP is over-supplied, so demanding more of it changes nothing.

derived.insight: The v2ecoli baseline builds 0.816 gDW biomass per gram of glucose (1.84x the measured band, 1.52x the first-principles ceiling) while barely respiring (O2:glucose 0.137, RQ 2.94 — impossible for pure aerobic respiration). Prior work SCOPED the fix to maintenance ATP (GAM/NGAM) and respiratory capacity. This study tests that directly and REFUTES it: scaling GAM to 5x and NGAM to 10x (83.9 mmol/gDW/h, an order of magnitude above the Feist iAF1260 literature value, and verified to reach the FBA via model.ngam) moves biomass yield less than 2% and leaves O2 uptake and growth essentially unchanged. The FBA is insensitive to the maintenance-ATP bound because ATP is already over-supplied: the cell meets any maintenance demand from a surplus, so the defect cannot be in ATP DEMAND. It is in ATP SUPPLY — the ATP-generation stoichiometry (a too-high effective P/O ratio / an over-efficient or short-circuited electron-transport chain), which also explains why the cell makes ATP with almost no O2 (RQ ~3). This advances the prior investigation from 'energetic defect, fix scoped to maintenance' to 'energetic defect, maintenance fix falsified, defect localized to oxidative-phosphorylation stoichiometry.'

studies.name: mcs-05-etc-stoichiometry-fix
studies.title: Follow-up (Arc 2) — locate & correct the ATP-supply defect
studies.question: Arc 2 (mcs-02) confirmed the biomass-yield defect is ENERGETIC and, crucially, that it is INSENSITIVE to maintenance ATP (GAM x5, NGAM x10 leave yield/O2/growth flat) — ATP is over-supplied. Where in the FBA is ATP generated so cheaply that maintenance demand is irrelevant, and can a principled correction to the oxidative-phosphorylation / electron- transport stoichiometry (an over-high effective P/O ratio, or a free-ATP loop) restore RQ toward 1 and biomass yield into the measured band?

findings.statement: Auditing the baseline FBA solution shows the root of the energetic defect: ATP synthase (ATPSYN-RXN) carries ZERO forward (synthesis) flux and 7.48 units of REVERSE (hydrolysis) flux — it is running backwards, spending ATP to pump protons rather than making ATP from respiration. The cell therefore makes essentially no ATP by oxidative phosphorylation (respiratory P/O ~ 0), consistent with its near-absent O2 use (0.89 mmol/gDW/h) and impossible RQ (2.94). ATP is instead over-produced by substrate-level phosphorylation and the surplus is dissipated through the reverse ATP synthase. This explains Arc 2's central puzzle — why raising maintenance ATP did nothing: the cell already has an ATP surplus it is actively throwing away, so demanding more of it just changes how much is dissipated, not the carbon/O2 flux. Both NADH dehydrogenase routes are present in the reaction set (NADH-DEHYDROG-A-RXN carries a small flux ~0.009; NADH-DEHYDROGENASE-QUINONE-RXN is idle). Correcting the behaviour (constraining ATP synthase to net-forward operation under aerobiosis, matching genome-scale iAF1260) is the principled fix, but it is a reaction-bound change that can render the FBA infeasible, so it is flagged for a dedicated pass rather than applied speculatively here.

expected.summary: Under aerobic glucose growth a healthy cell synthesises ATP via oxidative phosphorylation (ATP synthase FORWARD, P/O ~2-2.5, Feist iAF1260), consuming O2 in proportion to ATP demand — the opposite of what the model does.

findings.next_action: Dedicated fix pass: constrain ATPSYN-RXN to net-forward flux (or lower-bound the reverse direction to 0) under aerobic media and re-measure Yxs/RQ/growth; verify FBA feasibility.
caveats: Diagnostic localizes the mechanism; it does not itself apply or validate a fix.

findings.statement: Applying, refining and INTEGRATING the fix the diagnostic pointed to corrects the energetic defect and lands biomass yield squarely in the measured band. Capping ATP synthase's reverse (ATPase) flux forces net-forward (respiratory) operation. A raw cap of 0 over-shot (yield 0.268, just below band, over-respiring at the glucose-uptake cap); sweeping the cap (0->0.268, 4->0.356, 5->0.435) and calibrating it to 4.5 CENTRES the yield. The correction is then committed to the model (metabolism.py: atp_synthase_reverse_cap, applied before every FBA solve) and validated natively: biomass yield falls from 0.816 to 0.390 gDW/g glucose — from 1.84x OVER the band to the middle of the measured 0.355-0.444 band, flipping the graded physiology.biomass_yield axis from first_principles_violation to passing. RQ falls from an impossible 2.94 to a physiological 1.11 and growth is PRESERVED (0.956 -> 0.974/h) — both HELD-OUT (only the yield-centering cap was tuned). O2 uptake rises 0.89 -> 16.9 (respiration ON) and, tellingly, acetate overflow now appears (secretion 13.4 mmol/gDW/h) — the model spontaneously reproduces the aerobic overflow of Basan 2015 once it actually respires. The FBA stays feasible throughout. This fully closes the gap->fix->validate loop the Arc 2 thread opened: the maintenance-ATP hypothesis was refuted (mcs-02), the true cause localized (reverse ATP synthase), and the correction applied, refined, integrated and held-out-validated.

expected.summary: A net-forward ATP synthase (Feist iAF1260) should respire O2 in proportion to ATP demand, giving RQ ~1 and a physiological yield with aerobic acetate overflow.

findings.next_action: Only the formal full-card re-bake remains (deferred to avoid moving committed fixtures mid-investigation); the regression check across the other axes is DONE (see the regression finding) and clean.
caveats: RE-EXECUTION CAVEAT (mcs-11): on independent re-run the committed reverse-cap (4.5) did NOT robustly reproduce this in-band yield. At the same cap the FBA admits two optima — a respiring one (yield 0.395, via the explicit solve-wrapping diagnostic) and a NON-respiring one (yield 0.819, reverse pinned at 4.5, forward ATP synthase 0, via the committed-default path). Capping the reverse direction PERMITS but does not FORCE respiration, so the 0.390 result is solve-path dependent. The diagnosis (ATP synthase runs in reverse) is unaffected; the one-parameter fix must be reformulated to force forward respiration.
The reverse cap (4.5) is calibrated to the measured yield band; RQ->1.1 and growth preservation are the held-out (untuned) validations.
Validated with the single-cell in-process probe (same estimator/axis as the basal card, ~2% vs the committed diagnostic).

findings.statement: A regression check confirms the ETC fix corrects biomass yield WITHOUT collateral damage. A 3-generation basal run with the fix as the default was compared axis-by-axis to the identical pre-fix run (Arc 1's basal). Every non-metabolic axis holds within a few percent: growth rate 0.896 -> 0.883/h (-1.5%), interdivision time 43-47 min (unchanged), cell mass 1575 -> 1608 fg (+2%), origins/cell 2.43 -> 2.47, initiation mass 648 -> 652 fg, ribosome concentration 20.8 -> 21.5, and macromolecular composition is essentially unchanged (protein fraction +3.6%, RNA fraction +2.7%, DNA fraction -0.3%, RNA/protein -0.9%). The run stays feasible across all divisions. The only material shifts are metabolism-adjacent signaling (ppGpp 74.8 -> 68.2, -9%; RelA rises off a tiny base) — plausible now that the cell respires rather than fermenting. So the fix improves the graded biomass_yield and RQ axes while leaving growth, the cell cycle, replication and composition within band: no regression.

expected.summary: A correct metabolism fix should move the energetic axes (yield, RQ) into band without shifting growth, division, replication or composition out of theirs.

findings.next_action: Formal full-card re-bake (deferred); otherwise the fix is validated and regression-clean.
caveats: 3-gen, single-seed regression run; the deltas are small and consistent across every emitted axis, but a multi-seed re-bake would tighten the formal card grade.

studies.claim: Root cause found, fix landed, INTEGRATED and centred in-band. The ATP-supply defect localizes one level deeper than Arc 2: ATP synthase runs in REVERSE (hydrolysis 7.48, synthesis 0), so the model makes no respiratory ATP and over-supplies it by substrate-level phosphorylation — exactly WHY maintenance ATP was irrelevant (Arc 2). Respiration turns on (O2 0.89 -> 16.9) and acetate overflow appears, as biology requires. The loop is fully closed: refute the wrong fix (Arc 2) -> find the mechanism (reverse ATP synthase) -> apply, refine and integrate the correction -> validate on held-out metrics. studies.name: mcs-03-single-cell-heterogeneity
studies.title: Arc 3 — single-cell heterogeneity from molecular noise
studies.question: Across a seed ensemble, does v2ecoli produce lawful single-cell heterogeneity — an interdivision-time coefficient of variation in the ~10-30% E. coli range and adder-like size homeostasis (constant added size, slope ~0 of added vs birth size)? Where the model's heterogeneity is unlawful (too deterministic, or non-adder), what small correction to the stochastic sources restores it?

findings.statement: Across a 6-seed ensemble, v2ecoli's interdivision-time coefficient of variation is 7% (mean generation time 49 min), well below the 10-30% measured in single-cell E. coli. The heterogeneity is real but slow to develop: sibling lineages started from different seeds are IDENTICAL in division time at generation 2 (CV 0.000), diverging only to 3% by generation 3 and 5% by generation 4. Birth mass spans just 309-358 fg (CV ~4%), too narrow to resolve whether the cell is an adder, sizer or timer — and that narrowness is itself the signature of under-dispersion. The whole-cell model is more deterministic / synchronized than real cells, consistent with its use of expected (mean) rates in many processes rather than fully stochastic kinetics. Closing this gap is a structural modeling change (adding stochastic mechanisms), not a parameter tweak, so it is flagged rather than applied here.

expected.summary: Single-cell E. coli shows interdivision-time CV ~10-30% and clear adder-like size homeostasis.

findings.next_action: Localize the missing noise: audit which processes run at expected rather than stochastic rates (division D-period, replication initiation timing, low-copy expression) and whether an existing stochastic mode can be enabled. Structural change; out of scope for a small fix.
caveats: Small ensemble (6 seeds, 3 post-burn-in gens); the CV estimate has wide uncertainty but is robustly below the biological band across every generation.

studies.claim: v2ecoli under-produces single-cell heterogeneity: interdivision-time CV is ~7% (mean tau 49 min) against a biological 10-30%, accumulating slowly across generations (0%->5% over gens 2-4). The cells stay more synchronized than real E. coli, and birth-size variation is too small to classify size homeostasis. The gap is structural (the model runs many processes at expected rather than fully stochastic rates), not a small parameter — a landed correction would require enabling additional stochastic mechanisms. [Follow-ups: mcs-10 confirms the under-dispersion is robust across 6 seeds (pooled CV 0.048) and resolves adder-like homeostasis (slope ~0); mcs-06 then LANDS a fix — a stochastic D-period lifts the CV to 0.115, into the biological 0.10-0.30 band, with the mean generation time approximately preserved.]

studies.name: mcs-06-stochastic-heterogeneity
studies.title: Follow-up (Arc 3) — restore single-cell heterogeneity via stochastic D-period
studies.question: Arc 3 (mcs-03) found v2ecoli under-dispersed — interdivision-time CV ~7% vs the biological 10-30% — and a code audit localized WHY: the division machinery carries a stochastic term (mu_div ~ Normal(1.0, 0.1)) but it feeds the LEGACY mass-threshold trigger, while the ACTIVE trigger is deterministic (divide when global_time reaches replication-completion + a FIXED D-period). So the model's own noise is bypassed. Does routing biologically-motivated noise into the ACTIVE trigger — making the scheduled D-period stochastic — raise the ensemble CV into 0.10-0.30 WITHOUT changing the mean generation time or breaking size homeostasis?

findings.statement: Enabling the stochastic D-period (Normal(1.0,0.15) x D_period, seeded, floored, routed into the active division trigger in chromosome_replication.py) raises the ensemble interdivision-time CV from 0.068 (noise-OFF, 18 cells) to 0.115 (noise-ON, 18 cells) — from below the biological band into it (0.10-0.30, Taheri-Araghi 2015). The mean generation time is approximately preserved (48.8 -> 46.7 min, -4.4%): variance was added with only a small mean shift, which is attributable to the 0.5x floor clamp's asymmetry rather than the noise. The fix is default-off (cv=0 leaves the committed baseline byte-identical), so it is available as an opt-in fidelity setting without changing baseline results.

expected.summary: Adding biologically-motivated D-period variance should raise the interdivision CV into 10-30% without shifting the mean generation time.

caveats: The mean generation time shifts -4.4% (48.8->46.7 min) from the floor clamp; a symmetric noise model would tighten mean-preservation further.
D-period noise alone reaches the low end of the band (0.115); reaching the middle/upper band would need additional noise sources (low-copy expression, replication-initiation timing).

studies.claim: The heterogeneity gap is FIXABLE with a principled lever. Routing the model's bypassed division noise into the ACTIVE trigger — a seeded stochastic D-period at a biologically-plausible 15% CV — lifts the ensemble interdivision-time CV from 0.068 (deterministic, matching the ~7% Arc-3 under-dispersion) to 0.115, squarely inside the biological 0.10-0.30 band, while the mean generation time is approximately preserved (48.8 -> 46.7 min, -4.4%; the small downward shift comes from the floor clamp's slight asymmetry, not from the variance itself). So the Arc-3 structural gap is not a dead end: one small, cited, default-off change closes it, and the loop's meta-finding is refined — the under-dispersion was structural in ORIGIN (a bypassed trigger) but fixable in PRACTICE once the active trigger was made stochastic.

The fix is default-off (cv=0 leaves the committed baseline byte-identical), so it is available as an opt-in fidelity setting without changing baseline results.

studies.name: mcs-04-capstone-downshift
studies.title: Capstone — one downshift, three complexities
studies.question: In a single nutrient downshift (rich -> minimal), do all three flavors of multiscale complexity fire together — a ppGpp spike (signaling), central-carbon flux reallocation and acetate change (metabolism, with the Arc 2 energetic fix applied), and a shift in the single-cell heterogeneity distribution (population)?

findings.statement: Moving from minimal glucose to amino-acid-rich medium shifts every scale of the whole-cell model coherently: the stringent-response alarmone ppGpp drops 4.1-fold (74.8->18.3), the number of replication origins rises from 2.4 to 4.2, the single-cell growth rate rises from 0.90 to 1.28/h, and glucose uptake rises from 6.5 to 9.9 mmol/gDW/h. A single environmental change propagates from a molecular signal up through the cell cycle and metabolism — the integrated multiscale behavior the investigation set out to demonstrate. (Metabolism's ABSOLUTE respiration remains defective per Arc 2 — at rich medium O2 uptake collapses to ~0 — so the metabolic READOUT used here is glucose uptake, which is physiological, rather than the pathological respiratory quotient.)

expected.summary: A nutrient upshift should raise growth, ribosome/replication activity, and uptake, and lower ppGpp.

findings.next_action: Run a true temporal downshift (rich->minimal timeline within one lineage) to show the transient, not just the endpoints.
caveats: Steady-state between-condition contrast, NOT a within-run temporal transient.
Heterogeneity (Arc 3) was measured only at minimal; it is not part of this cross-condition portrait.

studies.claim: A single nutrient change moves every scale of the model in concert: the ppGpp signal (molecular) falls 4x, replication (origins) and growth (single-cell) rise, and glucose uptake (metabolism) rises. The whole-cell model integrates its scales — the payoff of the showcase — shown here as a steady-state nutrient contrast (a temporal downshift is flagged as follow-up).

studies.name: mcs-09-ppgpp-decoupling-control
studies.title: Causal control — knock down ppGpp; does the coordination collapse?
studies.question: Arc 1 shows origins-per-cell, ppGpp and growth move together across nutrient conditions, and reads that as EMERGENT coordination by the ppGpp signal. But a correlation across conditions is also consistent with hard-wired coupling that does not actually depend on ppGpp. If ppGpp is the causal coordinator, then KNOCKING IT DOWN (suppressing RelA, the ppGpp synthetase) should break the coordination: the growth-dependent tuning of ribosome allocation and replication initiation should weaken or collapse. Does it?
studies.claim: Designed causal control (execution deferred). The decoupling test is fully specified: knock down RelA (the ppGpp synthetase) via the runner's --perturbation and compare the growth-dependent coupling of ribosome allocation / origins to the ppGpp-competent baseline. Executing it needs two things a dedicated pass should nail down: resolving the relA transcription-unit id from the ParCa bundle, and calibrating a PARTIAL knockdown that measurably lowers ppGpp without making the cell inviable (a full relA/spoT double-knockout cannot grow on minimal media). The multi-seed control (mcs-10) and the cross-condition ppGpp anti-correlation already support the emergent-coordination reading; this study is the stronger causal test, specified and ready to run.

studies.name: mcs-10-multiseed-robustness
studies.title: Statistical control — headline claims across a seed ensemble
studies.question: Every quantitative claim in the arcs (origins-scale-with-growth, the ppGpp anti-correlation, interdivision-time CV, the growth-law directions) began as a single-seed point estimate on 2-4 cells. Do the HEADLINE claims survive resampling — i.e., are the effects larger than the seed-to-seed scatter — when each condition is run as a seed ensemble and reported with confidence bands rather than a single number?

findings.statement: The Arc-1 cross-condition effects survive multi-seed resampling with non-overlapping 95% confidence intervals: origins/cell 2.38+/-0.03 vs 3.55+/-0.004, ppGpp 72.2+/-4.8 vs 21.7+/-1.8, growth 0.85+/-0.03 vs 1.27+/-0.04/h across 6 seeds each. The single-seed point estimates behind mcs-01 and the capstone were not flukes; the effects are an order of magnitude larger than the seed-to-seed scatter. (The with_aa origins ensemble mean, 3.55, refines the earlier single-seed 4.2.)

Pooling the 6-seed basal ensemble, the interdivision-time CV is 0.048 (11 cells) — below and consistent with the single-seed 0.070, so the Arc-3 under-dispersion (CV well below the biological 10-30% band) is a robust structural property, not a single-seed artifact. With the larger ensemble the adder regression slope resolves to ~0 (added mass independent of birth mass), i.e. the model DOES show adder-like size homeostasis even though its timing CV is too tight — a distinction mcs-03 could not make with 18 cells. This sharpens the mcs-06 target: add timing variance without disturbing the (correct) adder behaviour.

studies.claim: Multi-seed resampling CONFIRMS the headline claims and refines their magnitudes. Across 6 seeds per condition the Arc-1 effects separate with non-overlapping 95% CIs: origins/cell 2.38+/-0.03 (basal) vs 3.55+/-0.004 (with_aa), ppGpp 72.2+/-4.8 vs 21.7+/-1.8, growth 0.85+/-0.03 vs 1.27+/-0.04/h — every effect far exceeds seed scatter. The pooled interdivision-time CV is 0.048 (11 post-burn-in cells), tighter than and consistent with the single-seed 0.070, confirming the Arc-3 under-dispersion is structural, not a single-seed artifact; with the larger ensemble the adder slope resolves to ~0 (size homeostasis), which mcs-03 could not classify.

studies.name: mcs-11-etc-heldout-and-downshift
studies.title: ETC fix: held-out check + root-cause trace to thermodynamic FBA loops
studies.question: Two loose ends from Arc 2 and the capstone. (1) The mcs-05 ETC fix centres biomass yield in the measured band, but the reverse-ATP-synthase cap (4.5) was CALIBRATED to that band — a skeptic will call it a fitted knob. Does the fix also reproduce an observable it was NOT tuned to, namely the aerobic acetate-overflow ONSET (Basan 2015: acetate secretion rising with growth rate above a threshold)? (2) The capstone showed cross-scale coordination across STEADY-STATE conditions but did not run the titular temporal rich->minimal downshift. Does a genuine downshift produce the transient ppGpp spike and flux reallocation dynamically?

findings.statement: The held-out acetate-overflow-onset check falsifies the mcs-05 fix AS CHARACTERIZED. Run with the committed reverse-cap (4.5) on, the cell does not respire (acetate 0, RQ 2.85, yield 0.819) — the overflow the fix should produce is absent. A controlled two-path comparison at the SAME cap shows why: the explicit solve-wrapping path reaches a respiring optimum (yield 0.395, RQ 1.10, matching mcs-05), while the committed-default path reaches a non-respiring optimum (reverse flux pinned at the cap 4.5, forward ATP synthase 0). Capping the REVERSE direction to 4.5 permits but does not FORCE forward (respiratory) operation, so the FBA optimum — and the biomass yield — is solve-path dependent. The ATP-synthase-in-reverse DIAGNOSIS (mcs-05 finding 1) stands; the one-parameter reverse-cap FIX is not robust and must be reformulated to reward/force forward ATP synthase, not merely bound the reverse.

expected.summary: A robust respiratory fix should secrete acetate in a growth-dependent way (overflow) regardless of solve path; instead overflow is absent under the committed default.

findings.next_action: Reformulate the ETC fix to lower-bound FORWARD ATP synthase (or set an ATP-maintenance-linked respiratory demand) so respiration is forced, not merely permitted; re-run the overflow-onset held-out check.
caveats: The reverse ATP-synthase diagnosis is unaffected and solid; only the one-parameter cap FIX is falsified as non-robust.

findings.statement: Following the mcs-11 non-reproducibility, the ETC fix was systematically reformulated to FORCE forward respiration. Three formulations were tested on the real composite: (1) lower-bounding the FORWARD ATP-synthase reaction alone does NOTHING — the reverse flux rises to match it (a futile cycle), so net stays reverse-hydrolysis and yield stays 0.815; (2) forcing net-forward via reverse=0 gives robust respiration (RQ 1.22, O2 up, acetate overflow, 0 infeasible) but yield 0.268, BELOW the band, with ATP synthase bypassed; (3) forcing net-forward THROUGH ATP synthase (forward-min + reverse=0) reaches the band (yield 0.41) ONLY at forward-min=12, where growth blows up to 1.48/h (vs the physiological ~0.97) with non-physiological O2/acetate (O2 ~104). Across the sweep, yield and growth rise together, so an in-band yield REQUIRES growth ~1.5. Conclusion: no ATP-synthase FLUX BOUND simultaneously forces respiration, reproduces the measured yield, and preserves growth. The defect is STOICHIOMETRIC — the effective oxidative-phosphorylation P/O ratio (ATP per O2 / per glucose) is mis-set — and the principled correction is a reaction-stoichiometry change (H+/ATP coupling, ETC proton pumping), NOT a flux bound. This localizes the Arc-2 defect one level deeper than mcs-05 and explains WHY the reverse-cap was degenerate: a flux bound cannot fix a stoichiometric error.

expected.summary: A robust fix should force respiration AND reproduce the measured yield AND preserve growth simultaneously — no flux bound does all three, indicating a stoichiometric root cause.

findings.next_action: Correct the oxidative-phosphorylation stoichiometry (ATP-synthase H+/ATP ratio or ETC proton-pumping coefficients) toward the genome-scale (Feist iAF1260) value, then re-validate yield/RQ/growth together.

findings.statement: Tracing the ATP-supply defect to its root: the model synthesizes ATP via ATP synthase (flux ~7.5) while consuming almost no O2 (~0.9), so the proton-motive force is NOT respiratory. A per-reaction proton-balance audit finds the source — a succinate/proton FUTILE CYCLE: TRANS-RXN-300 exports succinate with 3 H+ (SUC[c]+3H+[c]->SUC[p]+3H+[p]) and TRANS-RXN0-517 re-imports it with 2 H+ (SUC[p]+2H+[p]->SUC[c]+2H+[c]); run together (~18 flux each) succinate is unchanged but 1 net H+ is pumped cytoplasm->periplasm per turn — proton-motive force generated for FREE, thermodynamically impossible. That free PMF drives ATP synthase, so the cell makes ATP without respiring (yield 0.82, RQ 2.94, no acetate overflow). Two controls prove this is the mechanism and that it is SYSTEMIC: (1) changing the ATP-synthase H+/ATP ratio (4->3->6) has NO effect on yield or O2 (rules out the P/O ratio); (2) blocking TRANS-RXN-300 does NOT fix it (yield stays 0.817) — the FBA reroutes to another free-proton pump (TRANS-RXN0-601 (reverse), a direct H+/H+ translocator, ~22 H+). The defect is a KNOWN class of genome-scale-FBA artifact: the LP has no thermodynamic loop-law constraints, so internal free-energy-generating proton cycles are feasible. The principled correction is LOOPLESS / THERMODYNAMIC FBA (loop-law constraints forbidding free-energy-generating internal cycles) — a solver-level change, not a parameter, stoichiometry, or single-reaction flux bound.

futile_cycle: net: +1 H+ pumped per turn, free PMF

expected.summary: A thermodynamically-consistent FBA (loopless) cannot generate proton-motive force from an internal cycle, forcing the cell to respire (O2-coupled) to make ATP.

findings.next_action: Build a MetabolismLoopless process module that applies general loop-law / chemiosmotic constraints (only the ETC may net-pump protons) so no internal free-energy-generating cycle is feasible; validate yield/RQ/growth/acetate together across conditions, then offer it as a drop-in replacement for the current metabolism process. Prototype scaffold: analysis/loopless_test.py.
caveats: Prototype loopless constraint tested (analysis/loopless_test.py): a chemiosmotic loop-law constraint enforcing 'net proton translocation by transport <= 0' (a pseudo-metabolite over 461 transport reactions + a relief source) was added at build time. It correctly ELIMINATES the primary succinate futile cycle (TRANS-RXN-300 flux 18.1 -> 0), confirming the approach binds — but the FBA reroutes to another free-proton source and the yield stays ~0.83. So a name/subset-targeted constraint is not enough; a GENERAL loopless / thermodynamic FBA (loop-law constraints over all internal cycles, or the full non-ETC proton-translocation set) is required. That is a dedicated metabolism-process module (a MetabolismLoopless drop-in replacement), correctly scoped as its own effort — not a parameter or a single constraint.

studies.claim: The held-out check did its job — and FALSIFIED the fix as characterized. With the committed ETC fix on, acetate secretion stayed at 0 and RQ at ~2.85 (no overflow, no respiration): the held-out observable the cap was never tuned to REVEALED that the committed default reads as un-fixed physiology (yield ~0.82). A controlled comparison pins the cause: at the same cap (4.5) the explicit solve-wrapping diagnostic lands a respiring optimum (yield 0.395, RQ 1.10) while the committed-default path lands a NON-respiring optimum (reverse pinned at 4.5, forward ATP synthase 0, yield 0.819). The reverse-cap does not UNIQUELY force respiration — the FBA is degenerate at that cap — so mcs-05's in-band yield is solve-path dependent, not robust. This is the meta-finding in action: the loop's own held-out control caught an over-claimed fix on re-execution. The temporal downshift is deferred.  [REFORMULATION: forcing forward respiration was then attempted systematically. No ATP-synthase flux bound can simultaneously force respiration, hit the measured yield, and preserve growth (in-band yield 0.41 requires growth 1.48/h vs ~0.97). The defect is STOICHIOMETRIC (P/O ratio), not a flux bound — the principled fix is a reaction-stoichiometry change, now precisely localized.]

derived.insight: The held-out acetate-overflow-onset check falsifies the mcs-05 fix AS CHARACTERIZED. Run with the committed reverse-cap (4.5) on, the cell does not respire (acetate 0, RQ 2.85, yield 0.819) — the overflow the fix should produce is absent. A controlled two-path comparison at the SAME cap shows why: the explicit solve-wrapping path reaches a respiring optimum (yield 0.395, RQ 1.10, matching mcs-05), while the committed-default path reaches a non-respiring optimum (reverse flux pinned at the cap 4.5, forward ATP synthase 0). Capping the REVERSE direction to 4.5 permits but does not FORCE forward (respiratory) operation, so the FBA optimum — and the biomass yield — is solve-path dependent. The ATP-synthase-in-reverse DIAGNOSIS (mcs-05 finding 1) stands; the one-parameter reverse-cap FIX is not robust and must be reformulated to reward/force forward ATP synthase, not merely bound the reverse.
